programs.title: Shadow of a Doubt
programs.desc: Hitchcock thriller starring Joseph Cotten as a serial killer fleeing the law. Teresa Wright is his adoring niece who, initially, refuses to believe her uncle is a murderer.

programs.title: Drums Along the Mohawk
programs.desc: John Ford western with Henry Fonda and Claudette Colbert. In 1776, a settler and his wife attempt to farm in the Mohawk Valley but face attacks from Native Americans and the English.

programs.title: The Day After Tomorrow
programs.desc: Tense sci-fi thriller starring Dennis Quaid and Jake Gyllenhaal. Can a scientist save his son from a sudden climatic catastrophe.

programs.title: Fury
programs.desc: World War II action with Brad Pitt. A tank commander leads his crew into the dark, bloody heart of Hitler's last stand. But there's a rookie on board the Fury. With Michael Peña.

programs.title: Glory
programs.desc: Matthew Broderick, Denzel Washington and Morgan Freeman star in Edward Zwick's epic, Oscar-winning tribute to the first Black regiment raised in the North during the Civil War.

programs.desc: Mysterious fantasy-thriller following the lives of four people in present-day London and in a future metropolis. Starring Eva Green, Ryan Phillippe, Sam Riley and Bernard Hill.
